_doc: The One House run (scripts/town/one_house.gd, the scenario `OneHouse`): one survivor in one house of a big town, the same rules as the colony with the community modules switched on as people arrive. min_per_sec: game minutes per real second (2.0: a game hour is 30 s). difficulty: the run's difficulty (1 Standard). total_days: the run's nominal length for the clock and the briefing (the run really ends at the first held night, and `total_days()` is never less than the day after it). ideas_from_day: when the community starts to propose things. start: the hour of the first morning and the stores a run begins with (every stock named; the colony's full ones are not used). modules_from_crew: for each community module the number of living people (the avatar counted) from which it is on (99: never in this run). attack: from_rescue is how many rescued survivors make the dead come every night; cutoff_hour is the hour of day after which a fourth rescue puts the first attack on the next night instead of tonight. night: the size of the attack nights as a share of the colony's ordinary night (`first` is the first attack night, each one after is `growth` more). big_night: empty, or numbers of a Big Night theme (as demo.json) for the first attack night (brutes). held_rule: what a night needs to count as held at the dawn after it (the avatar or whoever leads is alive, no dead are in the house, a section of the base still stands). guide: the six lessons, in order; each is done when its cond is true (walked: tiles the avatar has walked; kills: the dead put down; rooms_seen: rooms of the house opened, or another house entered; house_clear; searched: containers searched; claimed) and none blocks anything. objective, words and end: what the player reads (%d and %s are filled in by the module). The enemy is 'the dead'.

guide.title: Walk
guide.text: W A S D walk Ruth, and the camera goes with her. The house is quiet. Enjoy it.

guide.title: Aim and shoot
guide.text: Hold the right mouse button to aim, and click to fire. One of the dead is in here with you.
guide.goal: Put one of the dead down

guide.title: Doors
guide.text: A closed door hides the room behind it. Walk through one and the dark lifts.
guide.goal: Open a door and go in

guide.title: Clear it
guide.text: Every room has to be empty of the dead. The count is under the objective.

guide.title: Search
guide.text: Stand at a cupboard or a chest and press E. Hold still while you look.

guide.title: Claim it
guide.text: Once the house is clear, stand inside the front door and press E. It is yours.

clear.sub_unknown: Open the doors. Mind what is behind them

claim.sub: Stand inside the front door and press E

rescue.sub: Clear a house, then talk to who is hiding in it

fortify.sub: Fence, gate, tower: order them on the Build page

hold.sub: Until dawn. Shoot, and mend what breaks

words.tagline: One house. One survivor. A town full of the dead.
words.new_game: One house and one survivor. Clear it, claim it, find people. When four voices are on the radio, the dead come every night.
words.new_game_caption: How hard the nights are, and the seed
fourth_tomorrow: The dead will come tomorrow night
news_fourth: The dead can hear it too. They will come at dusk, and every dusk after
victory: Dawn, and the house is still standing
defeat: Nobody is left to hold it

end.title: The night is held
end.line: Four voices, a fence and a roof. The dead will be back at dusk, and so will you.
end.full: The full game has more of the town to clear, more people to find and worse nights.
